messages:
elena.prod: Short decision thread: we need a minimal GA spec for reserved pools + burst behavior to include in the roadmap slide. keep it tight.
raj.eng: Proposal: GA conservative defaults only. headroom = 15% of pool (clamped floor 1 GPU), autoscale cooldown 300s, hysteresis 15%. carryover disabled by default, paid opt-in.
mina.infra: Ops constraints: enforce AZ spread (no AZ >85% reserved) and block any single region from owning >30% of global burst headroom. add admission control for tiny pools: if pool_gpus <4 then headroom_gpus = min(1, ceil(pool_gpus*0.15)).
cal.sales: Pilots asked for hourly windows; offer hourly as pilot opt-in but GA will be daily. carryover = paid addon, must be explicit in contract.
skye.se: SE asks: telemetry names needed for demos: dedicated.burst.tokens_used, dedicated.prewarm.count, dedicated.spillover.count, dedicated.headroom.by_az. Also need a simple burst meter UI.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: dedicated-ga-canary/us-west -> profile "conservative-burst" at 1769010000. report to #eng-telemetry.
elena.prod: Draft GA acceptance checklist (compact): 1) latency SLOs validated in two regions under conservative burst; 2) autoscale defaults set (cooldown 300s, hysteresis 15%); 3) headroom default 15% with small-pool clamp; 4) AZ spread and regional cap enforced; 5) telemetry emitted; 6) carryover disabled by default (paid opt-in); 7) docs for cross-region fallback + tenant region_affinity flags.
raj.eng: I'll run a short sim for the defaults and post numbers. due Wed EOD.
mina.infra: I'll run capacity projection with AZ spread constraints. due Wed noon.
cal.sales: I'll confirm pilot list and carryover interest. due Thu.
elena.prod: If sims look good, we lock these gates for roadmap and treat hourly/carryover as post-GA paid features unless a pilot pays for expedited support. thanks :thumbsup:
__notes: compact product thread; messages concatenated per agents.md rules
